summary.text: Mark Yonkman is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Republican incumbent Michele Hoitenga.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a sixth-generation farmer, former corporate executive and attorney who lives on his family's farm in Boon.

paragraphs.text: Yonkman graduated from Cadillac Senior High, earned a bachelor's degree from Kalamazoo College in 1982, and received a law degree from Wayne State Law School in 1985.
He said he practiced corporate and securities law and became general counsel for corporate finance at Comerica Bank, then general counsel and secretary and head of compliance at M&T Bank in New York.
After retiring from banking he returned to the family farm; he said he serves on his county Farm Bureau board, chairs its Policy Development Committee, and sits on his township's Board of Review.
Yonkman said his campaign focuses on agriculture, energy and defense and on bringing the views of rural Michigan voters to the Legislature.
